40b4a3598da1364e4d6ec9d1c8ff8ee01cbc347c.summary: IBM X-Force IRIS tracks ITG07, a threat actor that has intruded into geographically dispersed transportation-sector organizations over nine months. IRIS says ITG07 most closely aligns with activity other vendors call Chafer or APT39, which Symantec describes as an alleged Iran-based group. The report details a custom backdoor IRIS named TREKX, which NCCGroup reported in March 2019 as Chafer activity. ITG07 also uses legacy tools such as a custom Mimikatz, NBTScan, PsExec, webshells and remote access via Citrix, RDP and SSH-based tools. IRIS says ITG07 appears mainly engaged in surveillance…

40b21146d8883a66532a724f0e847cb1cc39e3d5.summary: NTT Security Japan's SOC describes Operation RestyLink, an APT campaign targeting Japanese companies, first observed in mid-April 2022. The report thinks it may have started in March 2022, with a related attack possibly around October 2021. Delivery used spear phishing, ZIP and LNK files, decoy PDFs, Word startup-folder persistence and DLL sideloading, with Cobalt Strike and possibly Covenant. The report names DarkHotel as the strongest suspect among four candidate APT groups but says there is no convincing evidence to confirm attribution.
